pre_registration.primary_correctness_endpoint: verifier pass or fail per attempt
pre_registration.win_rule: warm is a win only when the matched-pair cost delta is negative with a task-clustered interval that excludes zero, and correctness is noninferior to the margin
pre_registration.stopping_rule: if warm does not reduce provider requests per verified completion on a corpus that triggers expansions, stop

assignment.pattern: one shared sidecar for every attempt: <sidecar-root>/shared-warm

retention.ordering_rule: one workspace per (arm, sequence); the write-phase task and the read-phase tasks that follow it run in that workspace in order, and the runner interleaves arm order per repeat, so a write on the shared sidecar and in the workspace precedes its read

decomposition.cache_channel_note: ledger carries cache-read and cache-write tokens but no per-token cache price, so the cache channel is reported in tokens and is not folded into the USD split

claim.reason: at least one run has partial cost coverage, so total cost is unknown

cache_layout.note: 6 of 6 attempt(s) emitted no cache telemetry, so the layout view is partial and the flip count is unknown for those attempts, not zero

note: Every number comes from the captured authoritative request ledger. Tokens are provider-reported. A partial run withholds the total-cost claim.
